newsitem.title: USA: Florida Progress to redeem unit's prfrd.
newsitem.headline: Florida Progress to redeem unit's prfrd.

text.p: Florida Power Corp said on Thursday it will redeem an additional 25,000 shares of its 7.08 percent series cumulative preferred stock on November 16, 1996.
Florida Power, a unit of Florida Progress Corp, said it is redeeming the shares to meet sinking fund requirements of the series.
The redemption price will be $100 a share, plus an amount equal to accrued and unpaid dividends to November 16, 1996, of $.02 a share, the company said.

Florida Power also said that on November 16, 1996, it will redeem all remaining 200,000 shares of its 7.08 percent series cumulative preferred stock at the redemption price of $102.36 a share plus an amount equal to accrued and unpaid dividends of $.02 a share.
The record date for the redemptions on the 7.08 percent series is September 27, 1996. Funds for the redemption will be available on November 16, 1996.
